newsitem.title: USA: FelCor buys 2 Embassy hotels for $46.5mln.
newsitem.headline: FelCor buys 2 Embassy hotels for $46.5mln.

text.p: IRVING, Texas, June 30 - FelCor Suite Hotels Inc said Monday it bought two Embassy Suite hotels in Texas and New York for $46.5 million from Promus Hotel Corp.
The acquisition is part of a deal Promus announced on June 6 whereby FelCor will invest $100 million to buy five to 10 Embassy Suites hotes, to be managed and developed by Promus.

The 244-suite hotel in Dallas and 215-suite hotel in Syracuse, N.Y., are existing Promus hotels and the purchase price is not part of the $100 million available for acquisitions, said FelCor's chief financial officer William McCalmont.
Promus will continue to operate the hotels, which are franchised to FelCor under a 20-year license, as Embassy Suites hotels.

Under the agreement, FelCor and Promus will form a partnership for new each hotel FelCor buys. FelCor will take a 90 percent interest in each partnership while Promus, which will manage the hotels, keeps a 10 percent stake.
Promus traded at 38-3/4 Monday afternoon, down 3/8, while FelCor traded at 37-1/16, up 1/16.
